scripts.android:release: node load-env.js && npm run build && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
scripts.android:debug: node load-env.js && npm run build && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.cap:run: node load-env.js && npx cap run android -l
scripts.cap:sync: node load-env.js && npx cap sync android
